verdict.rationale: Figma ships a built-in 'Figma AI' agent that generates designs, edits images, searches files, and creates diagrams (figma-docs-17, figma-docs-34, figma-docs-51), fitting the delegate-to-assistant story. However, a first-hand community report states the AI tools (in FigJam, part of the same AI credit system) are 'really bad and often broken' (figma-comm-8), directly contradicting the polished vendor narrative. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the core Figma AI agent's reliability, and resolution of the FigJam AI quality complaints.
